title: Uka Transgresión ukax Quta thiyankiwa
intro: Mä armat quta thiyan laq’a patxaruw sayt’atäta, kawkhantix oladanakax mä divin kamachimp yant’at mä comunidadan jisk’at jisk’at arsu. Wayrax mä jan walt’äwit amtasiñampiw llakt’ata, ukax mä muspharkañ mayjt’äwiruw puriyatayna. ¿Khitinakas uka almanakajj utjäna, ukat kunjamsa yantʼapjjäna?
clues: Jiwasax mä comunidadankapxayätwa, Tatitusan mä qhana kamachi katuqapxirïta, ukampis uka kamachir jan yäqañatakix kunayman thakhinak jikxatapxta.
Mä uma jakʼanwa jakasipjjerïta, ukat uka umajj utjki ukanakatwa jakañasajj utjäna.
Akapachan jan wali lurañanakat jithiqtapxañajatak kamachipkäna uka uruw mä yantʼax purinipxitu.
Uma manqhankir animalanakajj uka pachpa uruw waljani nanakar jutapjjäna, jan aguantañjam yantʼapjjetäna.
Diosan ordenapar jan jitheqtañatakejj mä kʼari kʼarinak amuytʼapjjayäta, uka decretot sipansa jukʼamp yatiñaniw sasaw amuyapjjerïta.
Jiwasan jucha luratasax mä jisk’achañ mayjt’äwiruw puriyatayna; Allahan kamachiparjamax jisk’achat mononakaruw tukupxta.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱعْتَدَوْا۟ مِنكُمْ فِى ٱلسَّبْتِ فَقُلْنَا لَهُمْ كُونُوا۟ قِرَدَةً خَـٰسِـِٔينَ
verse: And you had already known about those who transgressed among you concerning the sabbath, and We said to them, "Be apes, despised." (2:65)
